# ASC

**Ambulatory Surgery Centers** (ASCs) are healthcare facilities that provide
same-day surgical care, including diagnostic and preventive procedures. They are
designed to offer a more convenient and cost-effective alternative to
hospital-based surgeries.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(ccn)
library(provider)
```

```{r}
asc <- ccn:::get_pin("asc")
asc
```

```{r}
provider::ambulatory(count = TRUE)
provider::ambulatory(state = c("GA", "FL"))
provider::ambulatory(county = provider::not_blank())
```
